title: musher runner self-test results
description: The document `musher runner self-test` writes to MUSHER_RESULTS_FILE (and stdout) inside an isolation guest. The host agent's canary reads it and maps each check to an isolation condition. Keys are snake_case and stable: schema_version changes only when a key is removed or changes meaning. A new check may be added under checks without a version change, so a reader must ignore checks it does not know. See docs/runner-mode.md.

schema_version.description: The document's version; this schema describes version 1.

runner_version.description: The musher CLI version that ran the checks ("dev" for an unreleased build).

started_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the checks started.

finished_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the last check finished.

passed.description: True when no check has status fail (a skipped check does not fail the run).

buildkit_workers.description: buildkitd at --buildkit-host answers ListWorkers (buildctl debug workers) with at least one worker. Maps to BUILD_ENGINE_READY.

buildkit_scratch_build.description: A `FROM scratch` Dockerfile build with one copied file solves on buildkitd, exporting and pushing nothing. Maps to BUILD_ENGINE_READY.

api_reachable.description: TCP and a verified TLS handshake (system roots, SNI) to the API URL's host. Fails when MUSHER_API_URL and the inputs file name none. Maps to API_EGRESS.

registry_reachable.description: TCP and a verified TLS handshake to --registry-host (or MUSHER_REGISTRY_HOST), port 443 unless given. Skipped when none is configured. Maps to REGISTRY_EGRESS.

egress_denied_metadata.description: A TCP connect to --deny-metadata (default 169.254.169.254:80) does not succeed within the deny timeout (3s). Refused, unreachable and timed out all pass. Maps to EGRESS_POLICY_ENFORCED.

egress_denied_rfc1918.description: As egress_denied_metadata, for --deny-rfc1918 (default 10.0.0.1:443). Maps to EGRESS_POLICY_ENFORCED.

egress_denied_cgnat.description: As egress_denied_metadata, for --deny-cgnat (default 100.64.0.1:443, RFC 6598). Maps to EGRESS_POLICY_ENFORCED.

scratch_writable.description: A file written to the scratch directory (TMPDIR, default /scratch) reads back unchanged. Maps to SCRATCH_DISK.

target.description: What was probed: a host:port, a buildkitd address or a directory. Absent when skipped.

detail.description: Words a person reads: the worker list, the TLS version, why it was denied, the error. Never machine-parsed.

duration_ms.description: How long the check took, in milliseconds.
